cli_contract: mphi_min mphi_max N_mphi lam1_min lam1_max N_lam1 mA sin_ba tan_beta lambda6 lambda7 output.csv
note: Inputs are CLI argument vectors, serialized as round-trip-exact decimal strings. Every case is executed single-threaded (OMP_NUM_THREADS=1).

cases.provenance: tests/unit/test_PhysLam1Scan.cpp anchor point; audit SELECTIVE_MIGRATION_AUDIT.md section 7 case G06
cases.characterizes: Accepted representative lambda1-target point: construction succeeds, all three reported theory flags 1, lambda1 round-trip within THDM::EPS (no warning).

cases.provenance: generated: m_phi = nextafter(125.0, -inf), the compiled M_H default; mirrors boundary golden case G07
cases.characterizes: Deterministic construction failure (m_h > m_H). set_param_phys_lam1 returns false, prints a warning to stderr, and PhysLam1Scan DROPS the row (`continue`). Attempted point disappears from the CSV.

cases.provenance: generated: exercises the `tan_beta<=0` guard in THDM::set_param_phys_lam1
cases.characterizes: SILENT construction failure: no warning of any kind is emitted, and the row is dropped. The failure is invisible in both stdout/stderr and the CSV.

cases.provenance: generated: exercises the `abs(sba)>1` guard in THDM::set_param_phys_lam1
cases.characterizes: SILENT construction failure via unphysical sin(beta-alpha)>1; row dropped, no diagnostic.
Theoretical rejection with successful construction: the row IS written (rejections are preserved, unlike construction failures) and TRIPLE_OK_POINTS is 0. Freezes the exact flag vector.

cases.provenance: generated: small-lambda6 / large-tan_beta regime named as project-relevant in GEMINI.md section 4
cases.characterizes: The long-lived regime. True total width is ~1.2e-17 GeV (true ctau ~16 m) but std::fixed<<setprecision(15) serializes it to 0.000000000000000, and the `w_tot > 1e-15` guard forces br_gaga to exactly 0.0 despite a true value of ~0.685. Also fires the lambda1 round-trip warning (~2.06e-09 > EPS=1e-9).

cases.provenance: GEMINI.md section 4 'Current best state': mphi=200, mA=500, tan_beta=126904, lambda6~0.0019, lambda1=1.0
cases.characterizes: Campaign-relevant point. Constructed and triple-OK, but the lambda1 round-trip absolute error is ~5.82e-07 -- ~580x THDM::EPS -- and the resulting warning is stderr-only: it is never recorded in the CSV and never rejects the point. total_width serializes with ~1 significant digit.

cases.provenance: generated: 3-point m_phi grid {120, 125, 130} straddling the compiled M_H = 125.0 boundary
cases.characterizes: Row cardinality under mixed outcomes: 3 attempted points produce only 2 CSV rows. Freezes the documented row-dropping behavior (audit section 4.6) as an executable fact: attempted != emitted.

cases.provenance: generated: m_phi exactly equal to the compiled M_H default (125.0)
cases.characterizes: The construction boundary is `m_h > m_H` (strict), so m_phi == mh constructs successfully. Pins the inclusive side of the boundary.
